name: Astribot T1
dof_breakdown: 23 excluding end effectors; swappable grippers or five-finger hands
price_note: US starting price (IROS 2026); ~US$13k reported for the China launch in May 2026
summary: The compact, cheaper sibling of Astribot's S1: a wheeled, cable-driven upper body launched in May 2026 and brought to North America at IROS 2026. It ships with Astribot's Lumo AI models and an embodied operating system; skills are retrained from operation and teleoperation data and pushed to the robot, not learned on the fly.
